risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, identifying segment-level revenue, margin, EBIT, cost, and pandemic effects, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and uncertain outlook assumptions. COVID-19, capacity and labor costs, declining legacy revenue, losses in Global Ecommerce, credit losses, tax estimates, and pension assumptions represent meaningful risks. Management maintains a cautiously confident tone regarding liquidity, operational improvements, and expected 2021 growth.
